expo.name: Almari
expo._comment:icon: PLACEHOLDER PNG. The brand source of truth is public/icon.svg at the repo root — rasterize it (see scripts/build-icons.mjs for the web pipeline) before any alpha build.
expo._comment:splash: PLACEHOLDER art. Splash should carry the brand mark from public/icon.svg on the dye-house ground; replace before alpha.
expo._comment:allowBackup: Android auto-backup is ON by default and copies the app's data directory into the user's Google account. A wardrobe document is a list of everything somebody owns and what they paid for it; 'local-first, your closet is yours' is not true while a silent cloud copy exists, and a restore can land the document on a phone that is not theirs. The one cloud copy this app makes is the sync the owner switches on per wardrobe, and it is off by default. Turning this back on is an owner decision, not a build convenience. Key checked against https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0/config/app/ (expo.android.allowBackup, boolean, defaults to the Android default of true).
